segments.text: At 46, at age 46, I came down with the virus and I thought I was going to recover and get
back on with my life, but I was then ill for the next five years and I was housebound
and I was so sick that I couldn't really take care of myself. I couldn't brush my
teeth twice a day, I couldn't shower every day, I couldn't go out for walks every day
and if I did it would take me days or weeks to feel better. I was diagnosed with something
called chronic fatigue syndrome and I was also told that oh by the way you're going
to develop fibromyalgia as well and this is as good as it's going to get, but something
inside me refused to believe that story and when I found functional nutrition nearly
five years on, I got to find out what the root cause was and the root cause was the
virus called Epstein-Barr virus, which many people have, 80 to 90% of the population
have it and it can reactivate itself at any particular time in a person's life. A
hormonal shift can reactivate it or stress, so perimenopause, childbirth or any life
stressors can activate it. So for myself at 46, I was probably in the early phases
of perimenopause and I found the root cause and once I found the root cause I was
able to target that and suppress the virus using nutrition, lifestyle and also
targeted supplements and as we know about long Covid, it was pretty much like that.
My antibodies were raised, so my body was acting as if I'd got an active virus,
so when you have an active virus what does the body need is rest, so that's what
was happening for five years and I healed in 2018. I went to my GP and said
can you amend my medical records to say I no longer have chronic fatigue and
she asked me, tell me about that, how did you heal and to cut a very long
story short I basically said well I healed my gut. So as part of my journey
in my perimenopause journey I realised that actually if we look at
the body as a whole, if we look at our body systems, if you understand where we
want to be, where we are right now, then no woman needs to suffer and that's
how I got into working with women in perimenopause because I too was in
perimenopause at that stage and have had an easy journey because I did
some deep work on supporting my body systems and therefore my menopause
journey wasn't challenging as it is for so many women that I work with now.
